title: Stellar Rises to Second Place in Tokenized Funds as Token Terminal Tracks $4.5B
description: Token Terminal's November 12 data places Stellar behind only Ethereum in tokenized fund value, with Spiko, Franklin Templeton and Ondo driving its expansion.
why_it_matters: Stellar's rise highlights how tokenized fund adoption can spread across issuers and investor segments rather than depend on a single product. The figures measure fund market capitalization, not trading liquidity or returns to XLM holders.
keyTakeaways: Token Terminal ranks Stellar second for tokenized funds at $4.5 billion, behind Ethereum.
Spiko's Stellar funds reached $2.1 billion, including approximately $1.6 billion in eurSAFO.
Franklin Templeton's Stellar fund value reached $1.3 billion; Ondo's USDY reached $538.7 million.
body:
Stellar has become the second-largest blockchain for tokenized funds by market capitalization, according to a November 12, 2026 analysis published by onchain data provider Token Terminal. The firm estimates $4.5 billion in tokenized funds on Stellar, up from $675.2 million and eighth place one year earlier. Ethereum remains the largest network by this measure.

The expansion spans several issuers. Token Terminal reports that Spiko's funds on Stellar reached $2.1 billion, including approximately $1.6 billion in its eurSAFO euro money market fund. Franklin Templeton's tokenized funds on the network rose to $1.3 billion, with its BENJI product accounting for most of that amount. Ondo's USDY fund on Stellar reached $538.7 million, compared with about $1 million a year earlier.

These are provider-reported market capitalization estimates for tokenized funds, not measures of secondary-market turnover, investor profits or the value of Stellar's native token. The mix of institutional cash-management products and Treasury-linked funds illustrates how issuance demand is broadening across different investor groups.

facts.claim: Token Terminal ranked Stellar second among chains for tokenized funds, with $4.5 billion in market capitalization.
facts.anchor: second largest chain for tokenized funds

facts.claim: A year before the November 2026 report, Stellar ranked eighth with $675.2 million in tokenized funds.
Spiko tokenized funds on Stellar reached $2.1 billion, including $1.6 billion attributed to eurSAFO.
Franklin Templeton tokenized funds on Stellar reached $1.3 billion, predominantly through the BENJI product.
Ondo's USDY tokenized fund on Stellar reached $538.7 million after starting the period near $1 million.
